implementation.bind_policy: IPv4 127.0.0.1 only; no import-time or automatic service startup
implementation.workers: Default 4, configurable maximum 16; excess accepted clients receive 503 and connection close
implementation.shutdown: Stop accepting new work and wait for in-flight handlers for the requested grace period; false means work remains active
implementation.deadline_semantics: Expired requests have their client socket shut down; already-dispatched application work is not forcibly cancelled
implementation.adapter_factory: Receives the bound port so exact Host/Origin policy uses the selected listener port

security_cases: oversized byte body rejected before dispatch

runtime_scope.ephemeral_test_listener: 127.0.0.1 on an automatically allocated port; closed after each fixture

limitations: The server module is not wired into a production launcher, service manager, or boot profile.
No bootstrap-secret provider or secure browser provisioning flow is integrated.
The HTTP deadline closes the connection but cannot interrupt a typed service call already executing.
Target-device fixed-port loopback, browser, client compatibility, lifecycle recovery, and private remote transport remain unqualified.
Management mutations remain disabled by default and require explicit opt-in plus the durable request store.
